author: ruixen.ui
name: ripple-circles
description: The RippleCircles component delivers a smooth and modern ripple-style loading animation using five concentric circles that expand and fade in a staggered sequence. Each circle features subtle gradients, semi-transparent borders, and a gentle backdrop blur, creating a calm, water-like ripple effect that blends seamlessly with both light and dark themes. Its elegant, minimalist design makes it ideal for loading screens, splash pages, or background indicators, offering a visually appealing and soothing way to indicate progress or waiting states without overwhelming the user interface.
